title: The Moment Woman’s Fake Robbery Call is Exposed
description:
Around 7AM on a Sunday morning, officers responded to a convenience store in reference to a customer threatening to beat up the cashier. The customer alleged that she was robbed of 20 dollars by the store and had stationed herself outside the entrance stating that she had no intention to move, unless she was paid back. The officers couldn’t make much sense of this confusing ordeal but it was obvious that they did not take a liking to the female’s demeanor. While this officer listened to the autobiographical ballad that the female sang in her angelic voice, Ashley, the cashier painted a complete picture of the incident. The officers were trying their best to get along with the female despite her obnoxious behavior. But the question that begs to be asked is: at what point, enough is enough? The female was charged with assault, battery on a law enforcement officer, resisting arrest without violence and trespassing.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
